name: espressif-p4-func-ev
title: Espressif ESP32-P4-Function-EV-Board
notes: ESP32-P4NRW32 (32 MB PSRAM), 16 MB flash, silicon v1.x (board v1.5); the ESP32-C6 companion isn't used. IP101GRI on the chip's MAC with IDF's P4 defaults (MDC 31, MDIO 52, REF_CLK in on GPIO50), PHY reset on GPIO51. Pins: esp-idf ethernet example (v5.5) and ethernet_init defaults, esp-bsp esp32_p4_function_ev_board (SDMMC slot 0, 4-bit, LDO channel 4). Earlier esp-idf (v5.3) had MDIO 27 and reset 26 for an early board revision. No LED the firmware can drive. A silicon v3 respin (ESP32-P4X) needs the esp32p4 image.
